explanation: `Set.domRestrict_def` is the unfolding lemma (proved by `rfl`) for `Set.domRestrict`. I grepped Mathlib for `domRestrict_def` and `restrict_def`. The only close matches are for other definitions. `Finset.restrict_def` is the same unfolding for `Finset.restrict`. `Subtype.restrict_def` states `restrict p f = f ∘ fun a => a`. That is a different definition and a different statement, so neither duplicates this lemma. The older `Set.restrict_def` is only a deprecated alias of the theorem itself. Nothing else in Mathlib states this unfolding for `Set.domRestrict`.
